in_sanskrit.name: जागा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jaga is derived from the Sanskrit word जागा (jāgā), which means 'awakening' or 'stimulation'. It is often used as a name for children to inspire a sense of energy, vitality, and enthusiasm in their lives.

in_hindi.name: जागा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Jaga in Hindi is जागा (jāgā), which is derived from the verb जागना (jāganā), meaning 'to awaken' or 'to stimulate'. The name carries the same meaning and significance as in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: ஜாகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Jaga in Tamil is ஜாகா (jākā), which is derived from the Tamil word ஜாக்கம் (jākkam), meaning 'stimulus' or 'excitation'. The name carries the same meaning and significance as in Sanskrit and Hindi.

in_telugu.name: జాగా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Jaga in Telugu is జాగా (jāgā), which is derived from the Telugu word జాగనదు (jāganadu), meaning 'awakened one' or 'stimulated one'. The name carries the same meaning and significance as in Sanskrit, Hindi, and Tamil.

in_marathi.name: Jaga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaga is a Sanskrit name that derives from the root jagati, meaning 'to protect, to guard'. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to signify their role as protectors and guardians.
